load_image: load an image file and return a normalized float buffer with EXIF rotation correction
resize_to_target: resize an image to a target max size while aligning dimensions to a multiple
save_image: save a normalized float image to disk as a standard image or raw binary file
load_raw_float32_image: load a raw float32 binary image file compatible with C++ CvUtil freadimg format
save_depth_map_colored: save a depth map and optionally generate a colored visualization using an external binary
